content:
sara: quick spike — built a tiny 'release-chef' that emits deploy-bot commands + a release-note stub from a service manifest. saves an annoying 5-10 lines we always copy.
aj: nice, can you paste an example output?
sara: sure — prototype output for service pax:
```
/release start --svc pax --image quay.io/rw/pax:20260320-9a3f --env prod \
  --window 02:00-04:00 --canary 5 --monitor true --rollback-policy smart
# release-notes
- summary: Pax feature toggle rollout
- changes: toggles X, Y
- followup: verify metric pax.requests.success > 99%
```
jamie: ooh 'rollback-policy smart' — what's the logic?
sara: smart = monitor for 5m stable, then step canary up; if error rate > threshold -> rollback to previous pinned image. defaults configurable.
mike: can we generate the release-note skeleton from service's CHANGELOG.md automatically?
sara: yes — chef reads manifest {release_notes_path} or falls back to changelog parse heuristic, attaches git shortlink for commits.
aj: what about pinning? I'd like the command to include an explicit --pin <sha> flag to avoid drift.
sara: done — template adds --pin if provided, and we auto-detect when doing scheduled releases.
release-bot: draft generated for pax by @sara at 2026-03-20 14:37 UTC — preview: https://internal/redwood/release/previews/1988123456
jamie: can we also emit a one-line CHANGE_WINDOW env var for infra to consume? example: CHANGE_WINDOW=0200-0400
sara: added that. final CLI snippet looks like:
```
export CHANGE_WINDOW=0200-0400
/release start --svc pax --image ... --pin 9a3fa1 --canary 5 --auto-notify on
```
mike: will add a small preflight that checks health endpoints and flag conflicts. also: include a small dry-run mode so the bot doesn't actually trigger infra during testing.
sara: already added --dry-run. next steps: tidy templates, add a tiny web form in console for non-cli folks, and run a 1-week dogfood with core infra services.
aj: :thumbsup: when you push the prototype branch ping #eng-releases and i'll try it on pax-staging.
sara: will do. thanks all.
